lines.lyric: Ajikdo kkumin geot gata oh baby
lines.lyric_hangul: 아직도 꿈인 것 같아, oh, baby
lines.lyric_translation: It still feels like a dream oh baby

lines.lyric: Imi neon algo itjanha oh baby
lines.lyric_hangul: 이미 넌 알고 있잖아, oh, baby

lines.lyric_translation: Though I drink coffee and open my eyes

lines.lyric: Jami deul geotman gata oh no no
lines.lyric_hangul: 잠이 들 것만 같아, oh, no-no
lines.lyric_translation: It feels like I’ll fall asleep, oh no no

lines.lyric: Geuryeobogon haesseo if I rulled the world
lines.lyric_hangul: 그려보곤 했어 if I ruled the world
lines.lyric_translation: I imagined if I ruled the world

lines.lyric: Neoreul dasi nae yeope dul geotman gata
lines.lyric_hangul: 너를 다시 내 옆에 둘 것만 같아
lines.lyric_translation: I would place you by my side again
Please tell me that it’s not too late
If this is a nightmare, please save me

lines.lyric: Jal bwabwa ajikkkaji nan neoman gidarineunde
lines.lyric_hangul: 잘 봐봐 아직까지 난 너만 기다리는데
lines.lyric_translation: Look carefully, I’m still waiting for only you
